name: Principality of Regensburg
alt: Electorate of Mainz moved to Regensburg

predecessors.name: Electorate of Mainz
predecessors.text: the Aschaffenburg and Wetzlar parts of the former Electorate of Mainz that Dalberg kept

predecessors.name: Holy Roman Empire (1260-1806)
predecessors.text: the Prince-Bishopric of Regensburg and the five Reichsfrei territories in Regensburg, and from 1806 the former free imperial city of Frankfurt

successors.name: Grand Duchy of Frankfurt
successors.text: Aschaffenburg, Wetzlar and Frankfurt, the base of the Grand Duchy of Frankfurt of 16 February 1810

rulers.name: Karl Theodor von Dalberg
rulers.title: Prince of Regensburg (Prince-Elector of Mainz until 1806)

ledger.x: 1803: Dalberg's Principality of Regensburg is created.
1806: the electorate becomes a principality of the Confederation of the Rhine.
1810: the Grand Duchy of Frankfurt is formed.
1810: the Principality of Regensburg ends with the incorporation of Regensburg into Bavaria on 22 May 1810; its Main and Lahn lands had already become the Grand Duchy of Frankfurt on 16 February.

certainty.note: Four separate territories (Regensburg, the Aschaffenburg land on the Main, Wetzlar and, from 1806, Frankfurt); no opened page gives a boundary, so the cells are approximate.

sources.title: Karl Theodor Anton Maria von Dalberg
